## Outcome

Runnable agent and provider API examples with a tested path for community contributions.

Task 8 of the nine-task Agent Behavior Trace Model execution plan following the August WG discussions.

**Why:** New contributors should be able to demonstrate their agent's behavior without rebuilding the test suite or depending on the original authors.

**Work:** Package the examples, test service, mappings, fixtures, and instructions. Exercise two provider integrations across the agents and add two standalone provider API examples for streaming, errors, tool-call requests, and available usage. Extract helpers only where reuse is demonstrated.

**Example:** A contributor whose SDK calls conversations “threads” documents that scope, maps the native identity, and runs the continuity checks. A provider-only example returning a `create_ticket` tool-call request must not report that the tool executed.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Done when:** the second agent validates the contribution instructions and another contributor can register a focused example with expected results, limitations, terminology version, and maintainer. Report standalone API coverage separately.

## Tracking

- **Workstream:** Agent Behavior Trace Model
- **Owner:** needs owner
- **Status:** needs owner
- **Next step:** Find contributors, select the initial provider pair, and package the examples and contributor instructions.
- **Depends on:** [Task 4](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/42), [Task 5](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/43), [Task 6](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/44), [Task 7](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/45). Provider cases can start once Tasks 3 and 4 are usable.
